name: Nuvem
notes: Floater: the runtime lifts it 7 px, adds the bob and draws the shadow. Anchor [16, 22] (the cloud's base). special-down (3 frames, loops) is a shower: five drops at uneven columns and phases leave the base (rows 23-24), fall (rows 26-28) and splash in a "^" on rows 28-29, row 29 being anchor + 7, the shadow; the cloud squeezes its eyes "> <", the underside darkens, the central lobe squeezes once. Moving it leaves a small puff behind (behind its trail in profile, over its top rear going down, under its base going up) that shrinks and goes. In profile the cloud is a chain of three lobes with a two-puff Kinto-un trail. sleep-down lies two rows lower and two columns wider with "u" eyes. Extra clips: blink-down (1 frame), look-down (2 frames).
